is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not report genotyping for any target markers. It discusses L1014F, L1014S, and ace-1 in the Discussion (Page 5-6) but cites a previous study (reference 25: Namountougou et al. 2019) for these findings.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele frequency data is reported for the mosquitoes collected in this study.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae from Bagane, a village in the Diébougou health district, southwest Burkina Faso (Page 2, Study area; Page 4, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary study reporting on insecticide susceptibility bioassays and the residual efficacy of IRS (Page 1, Abstract).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is tied to specific villages: Dangbara and Nipodja in the Diébougou health district (Page 2, Study area).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected and IRS was applied in September 2017 (Page 2, House spraying).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study is part of a larger randomized-controlled trial (RCT) in Diébougou, previously described in Soma et al. 2020 (reference 13) (Page 2, Methods).

supplement.evidence: The paper states all relevant data are within the manuscript and additional files, but the study design as described in the methods does not include genotyping.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the insecticide resistance status of Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) in southwest Burkina Faso and the residual efficacy of pirimiphos-methyl IRS. While it reports extensive bioassay data (WHO susceptibility and cone tests), it does not perform or report any genotyping of resistance markers, instead citing previous work for the presence of kdr and ace-1 mutations in the region.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report genotype data for target markers (only reports bioassay results and chemical analysis of IRS). Mentions markers in the discussion but cites a previous study (ref 25) for that data.
